description.value:
Worshippers of Nethys discovered a way to bind cantrips into cards, making them accessible even to non-spellcasters. The deck contains thick parchment cards, each roughly half the size of a typical playing card. In precise, no-nonsense script, each card simply states the name of its cantrip.

This pack contains 5 cards of a single common cantrip (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Light]).

Activate—Pick a Card 1 or more (manipulate)

Effect You envision your desired cantrip, causing its card to rise to the top of the deck, and draw the card. The deck casts that cantrip as a 1st-rank spell, with a DC of 15 and a spell attack modifier of +5. The card crumbles into dust as the cantrip takes effect. This activation takes the same number of actions as the cantrip you chose takes to cast.
